title: CHAM · Tân Lộc: eco-homestay project on Tân Lộc river island (Cần Thơ, Vietnam)
description:
CHAM is an eco-homestay project on Tân Lộc river island (Cần Thơ, Vietnam), first drafted by Đỗ Thùy Hương in 2023 and rewritten in 2026. This repository holds a public project description only; the full business plan and financials are not published.

Teaching case: bizonland.com/cham-homestay.html
